scope: One frozen two-state idle-word override and unchanged search configuration across all complete sources. Host predictions and artifact diagnostics, not a new audio release or actual emulator proof.
timing_scope: Per-source times include preparation, workset serialization, C execution, full rendering and artifact diagnostics. A resumed attempt is not a fresh full conversion benchmark; its wall time is reported separately. TRD assembly/emulator execution is separate.
decision: Reject unconditional idle-one-word promotion:five full-source SNR/RMS regressions versus matched-centered include speech0.190457dB and entertainer0.360775dB losses, with song0.009961dB lower. Lower silence noise and recovery versus reset-neutral remain useful mechanism evidence, but all four baseline comparisons and artifact increases remain explicit. Fitted indicators do not establish audibility or universal artifact absence. No new Fuse run or release promotion is warranted for this rejected candidate.
artifact_acceptance_scope: Compare compensation and half-joint at the unchanged original source clock. Legacy fitted modulation is inapplicable when drift breaks coherence. Regression counters disclose every numeric increase with arithmetic tolerance only; no user-supplied audibility threshold exists.
